pages.text: $(italic)A mythical beast of impossible speed. The fastest race in the game.$()$(br2)$(bold)Unrivaled Speed$(): the $(item)fastest sprint speed$() of any race.$(br2)$(bold)Wall Climbing$(): climb vertical surfaces like a spider.$(br2)$(bold)Cat Vision$(): see clearly in the dark.$(br2)$(bold)Fall Immunity$(): no fall damage.

pages.title: Traits (cont.)
pages.text: $(bold)Sprint Jump$(): a stronger jump while sprinting.$(br2)$(bold)Fragile$(): $(warn)-20% max HP$() (4 fewer hearts).$(br2)$(bold)Exhaustion$(): $(warn)constant movement burns food faster.$()$(br2)$(bold)Next: pair with Wanderer or Ranger and never stand still. Stillness is the only way you die.$()
